case_name: Anthropic PBC v. Department of Defense et al.
cause_of_action: First Amendment (freedom of speech; publication of model weights)
Due process — Fifth Amendment (notice and opportunity to be heard before ECCN designation)
IEEPA ultra vires (cyber-predicate extension exceeds statutory authority)
export_control_nexus: Challenge to extension of EAR jurisdiction over AI model weights and agentic systems under the Fable/Mythos directive; contests cyber-predicate enforcement mechanism
constitutional_issues: First Amendment — model weights as protected speech (Bernstein v. DOJ precedent)
Fifth Amendment due process — no notice or comment before ECCN designation
Non-delegation doctrine — IEEPA breadth as unconstitutional delegation
Void for vagueness — 'agentic system' undefined in EAR
tracking_notes: Key case for AI export control law. Watch for: (1) ruling on motion to dismiss; (2) discovery on classified AI capability assessments; (3) amicus filings from tech industry. Outcome could determine whether model weights receive First Amendment protection analogous to software source code (cf. Bernstein v. DOJ, 9th Cir. 1999).
